connectionSpecification.description: Reads deals, persons, organizations, activities, products, pipelines, stages, leads, notes, files and users from the Pipedrive API.

api_token.description: Personal API token of a Pipedrive user, sent as the api_token query parameter. The connector reads what that user can see.
api_token.title: API token

replication_start_date.description: Deals, persons, organizations and activities last updated before it are not read. Default 2010-01-01T00:00:00Z.
replication_start_date.title: Start date

connectionSpecification.title: Pipedrive Source Spec
